look: a male naga, a serpent-folk with lavender scales, a smooth snake head with yellow slit-pupil eyes, a pale ribbed belly, a muscular build and a long serpent tail
torso_tilt: first the top plane of the broad chest with its two pectoral muscles meeting at the breastbone, then, tucked under the chest, a short glimpse of the upper belly.
torso_paint: the torso as one broad chest with two full pectoral muscles and, below them, a firm upper belly of pale lavender ribbed belly plates

tail.paint: the tail as a thick tapering serpent tail in the same lavender scales
tail.guide: Behind the character a thick serpent tail lies on the floor: it comes out past the back, curls round toward the right of the picture, passes under the arm and runs forward to a tapering tip beside the feet.

notes: hands drawn 16 % wider than the draft: the legacy pack's world scale (0.0594, span 59 world px; naga_female is 156) makes a normal palm smaller than derive.PALM_MIN_WORLD, which would drop the grip pose
dome: smooth top of the skull, covered in broad flat lavender plate scales
face_paint: the head as a smooth top of the skull in broad flat plate scales seen from above with, in the narrow strip along its bottom edge, a natural naga face strongly foreshortened from above, a smooth scaled brow over two yellow slit-pupil eyes and a broad flat snake snout with two small nostrils
hands_paint: each hand with five well-formed fingers with smooth rounded tips
feet_paint: each foot front with three long toes ending in short pale lavender claws
